name: SoFi Unlimited 2% Credit Card

base_rate.description: 2 rewards points per $1 (2% cash back rewards) on all eligible purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Rewards points can be redeemed toward active SoFi accounts, such as SoFi Checking and Savings or SoFi Invest accounts.

notes: Currently invite only. Issued by SoFi Bank, N.A. under license from Mastercard. APRs and the foreign transaction fee are on the individual product page, which blocks automated access, so they are null. No Mastercard network package is stated, so network_tier is none.
